<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>package_private</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>sn_uib_on_call.OnCallEscalationPolicyUIBUtilsSNC</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description/>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>OnCallEscalationPolicyUIBUtilsSNC</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var OnCallEscalationPolicyUIBUtilsSNC = Class.create();
OnCallEscalationPolicyUIBUtilsSNC.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
        this.onCallCommon = new global.OnCallCommon();
        this.onCallEscalation = new global.OnCallEscalation();
        this.onCallRotation = new global.OnCallRotation();
    },
    TABLES: {
        CMN_ROTA_ESCALATION_SET: "cmn_rota_escalation_set",
        CMN_ROTA_ESC_STEP_DEF: "cmn_rota_esc_step_def",
        CMN_ROTA: 'cmn_rota',
        CMN_ROTA_ROSTER: 'cmn_rota_roster',
        CMN_ROTA_CONTACT_PREFERENCE: "cmn_rota_contact_preference",
        SYS_USER: "sys_user",
        SYS_USER_GROUP: "sys_user_group",
        ON_CALL_COMMUNICATION_TYPE: "on_call_communication_type",
        ESCALATION_POLICY_TEMPLATE: "on_call_template_escalation_policy",
        ESCALATION_STEP_TEMPLATE: "on_call_template_escalation_step",
        CONTACT_ATTEMPT_TEMPLATE: "on_call_template_contact_attempt",
        CONTACT_PREFERENCE_TEMPLATE: "on_call_template_contact_preference"
    },
    COLUMNS: {
        ATTEMPT_NAME: "attempt_name",
        ACTIVE: "active",
        CMN_ROTA: 'cmn_rota',
        CMN_ROTA_ESCALATION_SET: 'cmn_rota_escalation_set',
        CMN_ROTA_ROSTER: 'cmn_rota_roster',
        CMN_ROTA_ROSTERS: 'cmn_rota_rosters',
        CMN_ROTA_ROSTER_RTM: 'cmn_rota_roster_rtm',
        COMMUNICATION_TYPE: "communication_type",
        COMMUNICATION_TYPES: 'communication_types',
        CONDITION: 'condition',
        CONTACT_ATTEMPT: 'contact_attempt',
        DEFAULT: 'default',
        DESCRIPTION: 'description',
        DEVICES_LIST: 'cmn_notif_devices',
        ESCALATION_SET: 'escalation_set',
        ESCALATION_LEVEL: 'escalation_level',
        GROUP_ESCALATION: 'group_escalation',
        GROUPS_LIST: 'sys_user_groups',
        GROUP_MANAGER: 'group_manager',
        GROUP_MANAGER_FIELD: 'group_manager_field',
        NAME: 'name',
        ORDER: 'order',
        OVERRIDE_USER_CONTACT_PREFERENCE: 'override_user_contact_preference',
        PREFERENCE_TEMPLATE: "preference_template",
        REMINDERS: 'reminders',
        ROSTER_ESCALATION: 'roster_escalation',
        ROSTER_POSITION: 'roster_position',
        ROSTER_POSITION_RTM: 'cmn_rota_roster_rtm',
        ROTATE_THROUGH_MEMBER: 'rotate_through_member',
        SYS_ID: 'sys_id',
        SYS_UPDATED_ON: 'sys_updated_on',
        TABLE: 'table',
        TIME_BETWEEN_REMINDERS: 'time_between_reminders',
        TIME_TO_NEXT_STEP: 'time_to_next_step',
        TYPE: 'type',
        USERS_LIST: 'sys_users',
        USE_CUSTOM_ESCALATION: 'use_custom_escalation'
    },
    CONSTANTS: {
        MAX_NUMBER_OF_MANAGER_LEVELS: 10
    },

    getEscalationPolicyDetailsForSidePanel: function(rotaId) {
        var escalationPolicyDetails = {
            active_policies: [],
            inactive_policies: []
        };
        if (gs.nil(rotaId))
            return escalationPolicyDetails;

        var escType = this.onCallEscalation.getEscalationType(rotaId);
        escalationPolicyDetails.type = escType;
        if (escType == 'custom') {
            var cmnRotaEscalationSetGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ESCALATION_SET);
            cmnRotaEscalationSetGr.addQuery(this.COLUMNS.CMN_ROTA, rotaId);
            cmnRotaEscalationSetGr.orderByDesc(this.COLUMNS.DEFAULT);
            cmnRotaEscalationSetGr.orderByDesc(this.COLUMNS.SYS_UPDATED_ON);
            cmnRotaEscalationSetGr.query();
            while (cmnRotaEscalationSetGr.next()) {
                var escPolicy = this.onCallCommon.toJS(cmnRotaEscalationSetGr, ['name', 'description', 'active', 'default', 'order', 'override_user_contact_preference', 'table', 'condition', 'sys_id']);
                if (escPolicy && escPolicy.active && escPolicy.active.value == "true")
                    escalationPolicyDetails.active_policies.push(escPolicy);
                else
                    escalationPolicyDetails.inactive_policies.push(escPolicy);
            }
        } else if (escType == 'roster')
            escalationPolicyDetails.active_policies.push(this._getStandardEscalationTemplateJSON(gs.getMessage("Rotate through rosters")));
        else if (escType == 'member')
            escalationPolicyDetails.active_policies.push(this._getStandardEscalationTemplateJSON(gs.getMessage("Rotate through members")));

        return escalationPolicyDetails;
    },

    updateShiftEscalationPolicy: function(action, policyId) {
        var cmnRotaEscalationSetGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ESCALATION_SET);
        if (cmnRotaEscalationSetGr.get(policyId)) {
            cmnRotaEscalationSetGr.active = (action == "activate");
            cmnRotaEscalationSetGr.update();
        }
    },

    _getStandardEscalationTemplateJSON: function(escalationLabel) {
        return {
            "name": {
                "value": escalationLabel,
                "display_value": escalationLabel
            },
            "condition": {
                "value": "",
                "display_value": "",
                "label": gs.getMessage('Condition')
            },
            "table": {
                "value": "",
                "display_value": ""
            },
            "default": {
                "display_value": "true",
                "value": "true"
            },
        };
    },

    getCustomEscalationPolicyDetails: function(escalationSetId) {
        var escalationPolicyDetails = {
            escalation_steps: [],
            contact_attempts: []
        };
        var cmnRotaEscalationSetGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ESCALATION_SET);
        if (!gs.nil(escalationSetId) && cmnRotaEscalationSetGr.get(escalationSetId)) {
            escalationPolicyDetails = this.onCallCommon.toJS(cmnRotaEscalationSetGr, ['active', 'name', 'default', 'order', 'cmn_rota', 'description', 'override_user_contact_preference', 'table', 'condition']);
            escalationPolicyDetails.escalation_steps = this._getCustomEscalationSteps(escalationSetId);
            escalationPolicyDetails.contact_attempts = this._getEscalationContactAttempts(escalationSetId);
        }
        return escalationPolicyDetails;
    },

    _getCustomEscalationSteps: function(escalationSetId) {
        var escalationSteps = [];
        var escStepGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ESC_STEP_DEF);
        escStepGr.addQuery(this.COLUMNS.ESCALATION_SET, escalationSetId + "");
        escStepGr.addActiveQuery();
        escStepGr.orderBy(this.COLUMNS.ESCALATION_LEVEL);
        escStepGr.query();

        var totalTimeDur = new GlideDuration(0);
        var tempDur = new GlideDuration();

        while (escStepGr.next()) {
            var escStepDetails = this.onCallCommon.toJS(escStepGr, ['sys_id', 'name', 'escalation_level', 'reminders', 'time_between_reminders', 'time_to_next_step', 'cmn_rota_rosters', 'roster_escalation', 'sys_users', 'sys_user_groups', 'cmn_notif_devices', 'group_manager', 'group_manager_field', 'rotate_through_member', 'cmn_rota_roster_rtm']);
            var users = escStepDetails.sys_users.value;
            if (users) {
                users = users.split(",");
                var userGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.SYS_USER);
                var avatarsArr = [];
                users.forEach(function(userId) {
                    if (userGr.get(userId)) {
                        avatarsArr.push(userGr.avatar ? "/" + userGr.avatar + ".iix?t=small" : "");
                    }
                });
                escStepDetails.sys_users.avatars = avatarsArr.join(", ");
            }
            if (escStepDetails.group_manager.value) {
                var groupManagerFieldValue = escStepDetails.group_manager_field.value;
                if (groupManagerFieldValue && groupManagerFieldValue.indexOf("default_assignee") === -1) {
                    escStepDetails.group_manager_field.current_value = {
                        name: "",
                        level: 1
                    };
                    var manager = escStepGr.escalation_set.cmn_rota.group.manager;
                    var managerLevel = groupManagerFieldValue.split(".").length;
                    var mgrCurVal = escStepDetails.group_manager_field.current_value = {};
                    mgrCurVal.level = managerLevel;
                    for (var i = 1; i < managerLevel; i++) {
                        if (!gs.nil(manager)) manager = manager.manager;
                        else break;
                    }
                    if (!gs.nil(manager)) {
                        mgrCurVal.name = manager.getDisplayValue() || "";
                    }

                }
            }
            escStepDetails.total_time_to_cur_step = {
                value: totalTimeDur.getValue(),
                duration_value: totalTimeDur.getDurationValue()
            };
            if (escStepDetails.time_between_reminders.value) {
                for (var i = 0; i < escStepDetails.reminders.value; i++) {
                    tempDur.setValue(escStepDetails.time_between_reminders.value);
                    totalTimeDur = totalTimeDur.add(tempDur);
                }
            }
            if (escStepDetails.time_to_next_step.value) {
                tempDur.setValue(escStepDetails.time_to_next_step.value);
                totalTimeDur = totalTimeDur.add(tempDur);
            }
            escalationSteps.push(escStepDetails);
        }
        return escalationSteps;
    },

    getManagerName: function(sysId, managerLevel) {
        if (!sysId) return;
        var managerName = "";
        var manager;
        var userGroupGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.SYS_USER_GROUP);
        userGroupGr.addQuery(this.COLUMNS.SYS_ID, sysId + "");
        userGroupGr.addActiveQuery();
        userGroupGr.setLimit(1);
        userGroupGr.query();
        if (userGroupGr.next()) {
            manager = userGroupGr.manager;
            for (var i = 1; i < managerLevel; i++) {
                if (!gs.nil(manager)) manager = manager.manager;
                else break;
            }
            if (!gs.nil(manager)) {
                managerName = manager.getDisplayValue() || "";
            }
        } else {
            var rosterGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ROSTER);
            rosterGr.addQuery(this.COLUMNS.SYS_ID, sysId + "");
            rosterGr.addActiveQuery();
            rosterGr.setLimit(1);
            rosterGr.query();
            if (rosterGr.next()) {
                manager = rosterGr.rota.group.manager;
                for (var j = 1; j < managerLevel; j++) {
                    if (!gs.nil(manager)) manager = manager.manager;
                    else break;
                }
                if (!gs.nil(manager)) {
                    managerName = manager.getDisplayValue() || "";
                }
            }
        }
        return managerName;
    },

    getManagerLevels: function(sysId) {
        var escStepGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ESC_STEP_DEF);
        escStepGr.addQuery(this.COLUMNS.SYS_ID, sysId + "");
        escStepGr.addActiveQuery();
        escStepGr.setLimit(1);
        escStepGr.query();
        var levels = this.CONSTANTS.MAX_NUMBER_OF_MANAGER_LEVELS; //Returning this directly for Standard escalations
        if (escStepGr.next()) {
            var groupManagerFieldValue = escStepGr.getValue(this.COLUMNS.GROUP_MANAGER_FIELD);
            var managerLevels = groupManagerFieldValue.split(".");
            var numberOfManagers = managerLevels.length;
            levels = Math.max(numberOfManagers, this.CONSTANTS.MAX_NUMBER_OF_MANAGER_LEVELS);
        }
        return levels;
    },

    _getEscalationContactAttempts: function(escalationSetId, rotaId) {
        contactAttempts = [];
        if ((!gs.nil(escalationSetId) && escalationSetId + "" != "-1") || !gs.nil(rotaId)) {
            var cmnRotaContactPrefGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_CONTACT_PREFERENCE);
            if (!gs.nil(escalationSetId))
                cmnRotaContactPrefGr.addQuery(this.COLUMNS.CMN_ROTA_ESCALATION_SET, escalationSetId);
            else if (!gs.nil(rotaId))
                cmnRotaContactPrefGr.addQuery(this.COLUMNS.CMN_ROTA, rotaId);
            cmnRotaContactPrefGr.orderBy(this.COLUMNS.CONTACT_ATTEMPT);
            cmnRotaContactPrefGr.query();
            while (cmnRotaContactPrefGr.next()) {
                var attempt = {};
                attempt.contact_attempt = cmnRotaContactPrefGr.getValue(this.COLUMNS.CONTACT_ATTEMPT);
                attempt.sys_id = cmnRotaContactPrefGr.getUniqueValue();
                attempt.communication_types = [];
                var commTypes = cmnRotaContactPrefGr.getValue(this.COLUMNS.COMMUNICATION_TYPES);
                commTypes = commTypes.split(",");
                for (type in commTypes) {
                    var commType = commTypes[type];
                    var commTypeItem = {};
                    var onCallCommTypeGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.ON_CALL_COMMUNICATION_TYPE);
                    if (onCallCommTypeGr.get(commType)) {
                        commTypeItem.sys_id = commType;
                        commTypeItem.value = onCallCommTypeGr.getValue(this.COLUMNS.TYPE);
                        attempt.communication_types.push(commTypeItem);
                    }
                }
                contactAttempts.push(attempt);
            }
        }
        return contactAttempts;
    },

    getStandardEscalationPolicyDetails: function(rotaId) {
        if (!rotaId) return {};

        var rotaGr = new GlideRecord('cmn_rota');
        if (!rotaGr.get(rotaId)) return {};

        var escalationPolicyDetails = {};
        var rotaEscDetails = this.onCallCommon.toJS(rotaGr, ['sys_id', 'name', 'catch_all', 'catch_all_member', 'catch_all_roster', 'catch_all_wait_time', 'override_user_contact_preference']);
        var escType = this.onCallEscalation.getEscalationType(rotaEscDetails.sys_id.value);
        rotaEscDetails.escType = escType || "";
        escalationPolicyDetails = {
            ...rotaEscDetails
        };
        escalationPolicyDetails.escalation_steps = this._getStandardEscalationStepDetails(rotaId, rotaEscDetails);
        escalationPolicyDetails.contact_attempts = this._getEscalationContactAttempts(null, rotaId);
        return escalationPolicyDetails;
    },

    _getStandardEscalationStepDetails: function(rotaId, rotaEscDetails) {

        var escalationSteps = [];

        var rosterGr = new GlideRecord('cmn_rota_roster');
        rosterGr.addQuery('rota', rotaId + "");
        rosterGr.addActiveQuery();
        rosterGr.orderBy('order');
        rosterGr.query();

        var totalTimeDur = new GlideDuration(0);
        var tempDur = new GlideDuration();
        let rosterInd = 0;

        while (rosterGr.next()) {
            ++rosterInd;
            var rosterEscDetails = this.onCallCommon.toJS(rosterGr, ['sys_id', 'name', 'attempts', 'time_between_reminders']);
            rosterEscDetails.reminders = rosterEscDetails.attempts;
            rosterEscDetails.escalation_level = {
                value: rosterInd,
                display_value: rosterInd + ""
            };
            if (rotaEscDetails.escType === "member") {
                rosterEscDetails.rotate_through_member = {
                    value: "true",
                    display_value: "true"
                };
                rosterEscDetails.cmn_rota_roster_rtm = {
                    value: rosterEscDetails.sys_id.value,
                    display_value: rosterEscDetails.name.display_value || ""
                };
            } else if (rotaEscDetails.escType === "roster") {
                rosterEscDetails.cmn_rota_rosters = {
                    value: rosterEscDetails.sys_id.value,
                    display_value: rosterEscDetails.name.display_value || ""
                };
                rosterEscDetails.roster_escalation = {
                    value: "current_member",
                    display_value: gs.getMessage("Current member")
                };
                rosterEscDetails.rotate_through_member = {
                    value: "false"
                };
                rosterEscDetails.cmn_rota_roster_rtm = {
                    value: ""
                };
            }
            rosterEscDetails['sys_users'] = {
                value: ""
            };
            rosterEscDetails['sys_user_groups'] = {
                value: ""
            };
            rosterEscDetails['cmn_notif_devices'] = {
                value: ""
            };
            rosterEscDetails['group_manager'] = {
                value: "false"
            };
            rosterEscDetails['group_manager_field'] = {
                value: ""
            };
            rosterEscDetails['time_to_next_step'] = {
                value: rosterEscDetails.time_between_reminders.value,
                display_value: rosterEscDetails.time_between_reminders.display_value
            };
            rosterEscDetails['total_time_to_cur_step'] = {
                value: totalTimeDur.getValue(),
                duration_value: totalTimeDur.getDurationValue()
            };
            if (rosterEscDetails.time_between_reminders.value) {
                for (var i = 0; i < parseInt(rosterEscDetails.attempts.value) + 1; i++) {
                    tempDur.setValue(rosterEscDetails.time_between_reminders.value);
                    totalTimeDur = totalTimeDur.add(tempDur);
                }
            }
            escalationSteps.push(rosterEscDetails);
        }

        if (rotaEscDetails.catch_all.value) {
            var catchAllStepDetails = {};
            ++rosterInd;
            catchAllStepDetails.name = {
                value: "catch_all",
                display_value: gs.getMessage("Catch-all")
            };
            catchAllStepDetails.escalation_level = {
                value: rosterInd,
                display_value: rosterInd + ""
            };
            if (rotaEscDetails.catch_all.value === "individual") {
                var catchAllUserGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.SYS_USER);
                if (catchAllUserGr.get(rotaEscDetails.catch_all_member.value)) {
                    var avatar = catchAllUserGr.avatar ? "/" + catchAllUserGr.avatar + ".iix?t=small" : "";
                    catchAllStepDetails.sys_users = {
                        value: catchAllUserGr.getUniqueValue(),
                        display_value: catchAllUserGr.getDisplayValue() || "",
                        avatars: avatar
                    };
                }
            } else if (rotaEscDetails.catch_all.value === "all") {
                var catchAllRosterGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ROSTER);
                if (catchAllRosterGr.get(rotaEscDetails.catch_all_roster.value)) {
                    catchAllStepDetails.cmn_rota_rosters = {
                        value: catchAllRosterGr.getUniqueValue(),
                        display_value: catchAllRosterGr.getDisplayValue() || ""
                    };
                    catchAllStepDetails.roster_escalation = {
                        value: "all_members",
                        display_value: gs.getMessage("All members")
                    };
                }
            } else if (rotaEscDetails.catch_all.value === "group_manager") {
                catchAllStepDetails.group_manager = {
                    value: "true",
                    display_value: "true"
                };
                catchAllStepDetails.group_manager_field = {
                    value: "manager",
                    display_value: "Manager",
                    current_value: {
                        name: "",
                        level: 1
                    }
                };
                var manager = rosterGr.rota.group.manager;
                if (!gs.nil(manager)) {
                    catchAllStepDetails.group_manager_field.current_value.name = manager.getDisplayValue() || "";
                }
            }
            catchAllStepDetails['reminders'] = {
                value: "",
                display_value: ""
            };
            catchAllStepDetails['time_between_reminders'] = {
                value: "",
                display_value: ""
            };
            catchAllStepDetails['total_time_to_cur_step'] = {
                value: totalTimeDur.getValue(),
                duration_value: totalTimeDur.getDurationValue()
            };
            var catchAllWaitTime = rotaEscDetails.catch_all_wait_time;
            if (catchAllWaitTime.value) {
                catchAllStepDetails['time_to_next_step'] = {
                    value: catchAllWaitTime.value,
                    display_value: rotaEscDetails.catch_all_wait_time.display_value
                };
            } else {
                var defaultCatchAllWaitTime = gs.getProperty("com.snc.on_call_rotation.catch_all_wait_time", 900);
                var catchAllWaitTimeDur = new GlideDuration(defaultCatchAllWaitTime * 1000);
                catchAllStepDetails['time_to_next_step'] = {
                    value: catchAllWaitTimeDur.getValue(),
                    display_value: catchAllWaitTimeDur.getDisplayValue()
                };
            }
            escalationSteps.push(catchAllStepDetails);
        }

        if (rotaEscDetails.catch_all) {
            //handle this case
        }

        return escalationSteps;

    },

    deleteRecord: function(table, recordId) {
        if (table === this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ESCALATION_SET) return this._deleteCustomEscalationPolicy(recordId);
        if (table === this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ESC_STEP_DEF) return this._deleteCustomEscalationStep(recordId);
        if (table === this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_CONTACT_PREFERENCE) return this._deleteCustomEscalationContactPref(recordId);
        return this._onExit(false, []);
    },

    _deleteCustomEscalationPolicy: function(escalationSetId) {
        var escalationSetGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ESCALATION_SET);
        var errors = [];
        if (!escalationSetGr.get(escalationSetId)) {
            errors = [gs.getMessage("Escalation policy record not found")];
            return this._onExit(false, []);
        } else if (!escalationSetGr.canDelete()) {
            errors = [gs.getMessage("Not authorized to delete escalation policy")];
            return this._onExit(false, errors);
        } else if (!escalationSetGr.deleteRecord()) {
            errors = [gs.getMessage("Failed to delete escalation policy")];
            return this._onExit(false, errors);
        }
        return this._onExit(true, []);

    },

    _deleteCustomEscalationStep: function(escalationStepId) {
        var escalationStepGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ESC_STEP_DEF);
        var errors = [];
        if (!escalationStepGr.get(escalationStepId)) {
            errors = [gs.getMessage("Escalation step record not found")];
            return this._onExit(false, errors);
        } else if (!escalationStepGr.canDelete()) {
            errors = [gs.getMessage("Not authorized to delete escalation step")];
            return this._onExit(false, errors);
        } else if (!escalationStepGr.deleteRecord()) {
            errors = [gs.getMessage("Failed to delete escalation step")];
            return this._onExit(false, errors);
        }
        return this._onExit(true, []);
    },

    _deleteCustomEscalationContactPref: function(contactPrefId) {
        var contactPrefGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_CONTACT_PREFERENCE);
        var errors = [];
        if (!contactPrefGr.get(contactPrefId)) {
            errors = [gs.getMessage("Contact preference record not found")];
            return this._onExit(false, errors);
        } else if (!contactPrefGr.canDelete()) {
            errors = [gs.getMessage("Not authorized to delete contact preference")];
            return this._onExit(false, errors);
        } else if (!contactPrefGr.deleteRecord()) {
            errors = [gs.getMessage("Failed to delete contact preference")];
            return this._onExit(false, errors);
        }
        return this._onExit(true, []);

    },

    migrateToCustomEscalationPolicy: function(table, escalationPolicyData) {
        var rotaGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA);
        if (!rotaGr.get(escalationPolicyData.basic_info.cmn_rota)) {
            return this._onExit(false, []);
        }
        var res = this._onExit(false, []);
        if (table && table !== this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ESCALATION_SET) {
            res = this._populateCustomEscalationData(escalationPolicyData, true);
        }
        if (res.success) {
            rotaGr.setValue(this.COLUMNS.USE_CUSTOM_ESCALATION, true);
            rotaGr.update();
        }
        return res;
    },

    populateCustomEscalationData: function(escalationPolicyData, contactPrefTemplateId) {
        return this._populateCustomEscalationData(escalationPolicyData, false, contactPrefTemplateId);
    },

    _populateCustomEscalationData: function(escalationPolicyData, createNew, contactPrefTemplateId) {
        if (gs.nil(escalationPolicyData)) return this._onExit(false, []);

        var errors = [];
        var isInsert = createNew || (escalationPolicyData.sys_id + "" === "-1");
        var isUpdate = escalationPolicyData.is_dirty;

        if (isInsert) {
            var groupEscalationGr = this.onCallRotation.getGroupEscalationGr(escalationPolicyData.basic_info.cmn_rota);
            if (groupEscalationGr) {
                errors = [gs.getMessage("Creation of new escalation policy not supported while group escalation is in place")];
                return this._onExit(false, errors);
            }
        }

        var basicInfo = escalationPolicyData.basic_info;
        var conditions = escalationPolicyData.conditions;
        var escalationSteps = escalationPolicyData.escalation_steps;
        var escalationNotifications = escalationPolicyData.escalation_notifications;

        var escalationSetGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ESCALATION_SET);
        if (isInsert) {
            escalationSetGr.initialize();
            if (!escalationSetGr.canCreate()) {
                errors = [gs.getMessage("Not authorized to create new escalation policy")];
                return this._onExit(false, errors);
            }
        } else if (isUpdate) {
            if (!escalationSetGr.get(escalationPolicyData.sys_id)) {
                return this._onExit(false, []);
            }
            if (!escalationSetGr.canWrite()) {
                errors = [gs.getMessage("Not authorized to update escalation policy")];
                return this._onExit(false, errors);
            }
        } else {
            return this._onExit(true, []);
        }

        var rotaGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA);
        if (!rotaGr.get(escalationPolicyData.basic_info.cmn_rota)) {
            errors = [gs.getMessage("Invalid shift")];
            return this._onExit(false, errors);
        }

        this._setValue(escalationSetGr, this.COLUMNS.NAME, basicInfo.name);
        this._setValue(escalationSetGr, this.COLUMNS.ACTIVE, basicInfo.active);
        this._setValue(escalationSetGr, this.COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION, basicInfo.description);
        this._setValue(escalationSetGr, this.COLUMNS.DEFAULT, basicInfo.default);
        this._setValue(escalationSetGr, this.COLUMNS.ORDER, basicInfo.order);
        this._setValue(escalationSetGr, this.COLUMNS.CMN_ROTA, basicInfo.cmn_rota);
        this._setValue(escalationSetGr, this.COLUMNS.OVERRIDE_USER_CONTACT_PREFERENCE, escalationNotifications.override_user_contact_preference);

        if (basicInfo.default && conditions.encoded_query) {
            errors = [gs.getMessage("Default policy cannot have conditions")];
            return this._onExit(false, errors);
        }
        this._setValue(escalationSetGr, this.COLUMNS.TABLE, conditions.table);
        this._setValue(escalationSetGr, this.COLUMNS.CONDITION, conditions.encoded_query);

        if (isInsert && !escalationSetGr.insert()) {
            if (escalationPolicyData.escalation_policy_type === "custom") {
                errors = [gs.getMessage("Failed to create escalation policy")];
            } else {
                errors = [gs.getMessage("Failed to update escalation policy")];
            }
            return this._onExit(false, errors);
        }
        if (!isInsert && isUpdate && !escalationSetGr.update()) {
            errors = [gs.getMessage("Failed to update escalation policy")];
            return this._onExit(false, errors);
        }

        if (isInsert) {
            rotaGr.setValue(this.COLUMNS.USE_CUSTOM_ESCALATION, true);
            rotaGr.update();
        }

        var payload = {};
        payload.escalationSetId = escalationSetGr.getUniqueValue();

        var stepsResult = this._populateCustomEscalationSteps(escalationSetGr.getUniqueValue(), escalationSteps, createNew);
        if (!stepsResult.success) {
            errors = errors.concat(stepsResult.errors);
            return this._onExit(false, errors, payload);
        }

        var notificationsResult = this._populateCustomEscalationContactPref(escalationSetGr.getUniqueValue(), escalationNotifications, createNew);
        if (!notificationsResult.success) {
            errors = errors.concat(notificationsResult.errors);
            return this._onExit(false, errors, payload);
        }

        return this._onExit(true, [], payload);
    },

    _populateCustomEscalationSteps: function(escalationSetId, escalationSteps, createNew) {

        var escStepIds = [];

        if (!escalationSetId || !escalationSteps) return this._onExit(false, []);

        for (var i = 0; i < escalationSteps.steps.length; i++) {
            var step = escalationSteps.steps[i];
            var escalationStepGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ESC_STEP_DEF);
            var isInsert = createNew || (step.sys_id + "" === "-1");
            var isUpdate = step.is_dirty;

            if (isInsert) {
                escalationStepGr.initialize();
                if (!escalationStepGr.canCreate()) {
                    var errors = [gs.getMessage("Not authorized to create new escalation step")];
                    return this._onExit(false, errors);
                }
            } else if (isUpdate) {
                if (!escalationStepGr.get(step.sys_id)) {
                    return this._onExit(false, errors);
                }
                if (!escalationStepGr.canWrite()) {
                    var errors = [gs.getMessage("Not authorized to update escalation step")];
                    return this._onExit(false, errors);
                }
            } else {
                continue;
            }

            this._setValue(escalationStepGr, this.COLUMNS.NAME, step.name);
            this._setValue(escalationStepGr, this.COLUMNS.ESCALATION_SET, escalationSetId);
            this._setValue(escalationStepGr, this.COLUMNS.ESCALATION_LEVEL, step.escalation_level);
            this._setValue(escalationStepGr, this.COLUMNS.ROTATE_THROUGH_MEMBER, step.rotate_through_member);

            this._setValue(escalationStepGr, this.COLUMNS.REMINDERS, step.reminders);
            this._setValue(escalationStepGr, this.COLUMNS.TIME_BETWEEN_REMINDERS, step.time_between_reminders);
            this._setValue(escalationStepGr, this.COLUMNS.TIME_TO_NEXT_STEP, step.time_to_next_step);

            this._setValue(escalationStepGr, this.COLUMNS.USERS_LIST, step.sys_users);
            this._setValue(escalationStepGr, this.COLUMNS.GROUPS_LIST, step.sys_user_groups);
            this._setValue(escalationStepGr, this.COLUMNS.DEVICES_LIST, step.cmn_notif_devices);

            this._setValue(escalationStepGr, this.COLUMNS.CMN_ROTA_ROSTERS, step.cmn_rota_rosters);
            this._setValue(escalationStepGr, this.COLUMNS.CMN_ROTA_ROSTER_RTM, step.cmn_rota_roster_rtm);
            this._setValue(escalationStepGr, this.COLUMNS.ROSTER_ESCALATION, step.roster_escalation);

            this._setValue(escalationStepGr, this.COLUMNS.GROUP_MANAGER, step.group_manager);
            this._setValue(escalationStepGr, this.COLUMNS.GROUP_MANAGER_FIELD, step.group_manager_field);

            if (isInsert && !escalationStepGr.insert()) {
                errors = [gs.getMessage("Failed to create escalation step")];
                return this._onExit(false, errors);
            }
            if (!isInsert && isUpdate && !escalationStepGr.update()) {
                errors = [gs.getMessage("Failed to update escalation step")];
                return this._onExit(false, errors);
            }

            escStepIds.push(escalationStepGr.getUniqueValue());
        }

        escalationStepGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ESC_STEP_DEF);
        escalationStepGr.addQuery(this.COLUMNS.SYS_ID, 'IN', escStepIds);
        escalationStepGr.query();

        return this._onExit(true, []);
    },

    _populateCustomEscalationContactPref: function(escalationSetId, escalationNotifications, createNew, contactPrefTemplateId) {

        var contactPrefIds = [];

        if (!escalationSetId || !escalationNotifications) return this._onExit(false, []);

        for (var i = 0; i < escalationNotifications.notifications.length; i++) {
            var notification = escalationNotifications.notifications[i];
            var isInsert = createNew || (notification.sys_id + "" === "-1");
            var isUpdate = notification.is_dirty;
            var contactPrefGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_CONTACT_PREFERENCE);
            if (isInsert) {
                contactPrefGr.initialize();
                if (!contactPrefGr.canCreate()) {
                    var errors = [gs.getMessage("Not authorized to create new contact preference")];
                    return this._onExit(false, errors);
                }
            } else if (isUpdate) {
                if (!contactPrefGr.get(notification.sys_id)) {
                    return this._onExit(false, []);
                }
                if (!contactPrefGr.canWrite()) {
                    var errors = [gs.getMessage("Not authorized to update contact preference")];
                    return this._onExit(false, errors);
                }
            } else {
                continue;
            }

            this._setValue(contactPrefGr, this.COLUMNS.CMN_ROTA_ESCALATION_SET, escalationSetId);
            this._setValue(contactPrefGr, this.COLUMNS.TYPE, notification.type);
            this._setValue(contactPrefGr, this.COLUMNS.CONTACT_ATTEMPT, notification.contact_attempt);
            this._setValue(contactPrefGr, this.COLUMNS.COMMUNICATION_TYPES, notification.communication_types);

            if (isInsert && !contactPrefGr.insert()) {
                var errors = [gs.getMessage("Failed to create contact preference")];
                return this._onExit(false, errors);
            }
            if (!isInsert && isUpdate && !contactPrefGr.update()) {
                var errors = [gs.getMessage("Failed to update contact preference")];
                return this._onExit(false, errors);
            }

            contactPrefIds.push(contactPrefGr.getUniqueValue());
        }

        contactPrefGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_CONTACT_PREFERENCE);
        contactPrefGr.addQuery(this.COLUMNS.SYS_ID, 'IN', contactPrefIds);
        contactPrefGr.query();

        return this._onExit(true, []);
    },

    _setValue: function(gr, field, val) {
        if (!gr || !field || !gr.isValidField(field) || val === undefined || val === null) return;
        gr.setValue(field, val);
    },

    _onExit: function(success, errors, payload) {
        var result = {
            success: success
        };
        if (payload) result['payload'] = payload;
        result['errors'] = errors || [];
        return result;
    },
    _transformRosterFromTemplate: function(rosters, shiftId) {
        var rosterNumbers = rosters.value ? rosters.value.split(",") : [];
        var rosterGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ROSTER);
        rosterGr.addQuery("rota", shiftId);
        rosterGr.addActiveQuery();
        rosterGr.orderBy("order");
        rosterGr.query();
        var rosterList = [];
        while (rosterGr.next()) {
            rosterList.push({
                value: rosterGr.getUniqueValue(),
                display_value: rosterGr.getDisplayValue()
            });
        }
        var result = {
            value: "",
            display_value: "",
            label: gs.getMessage("Rosters")
        };
        for (var i = 0; i < rosterNumbers.length; i++) {
            if (!rosterList[rosterNumbers[i] - 1])
                continue;
            else {
                if (result.value == "") {
                    result.value = rosterList[rosterNumbers[i] - 1].value;
                    result.display_value = rosterList[rosterNumbers[i] - 1].display_value;
                } else {
                    result.value += ", " + rosterList[rosterNumbers[i] - 1].value;
                    result.display_value += ", " + rosterList[rosterNumbers[i] - 1].display_value;
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    },
    _transformRosterFromTemplateRTM: function(rosters, shiftId) {
        var rosterNumber = rosters.value;
        var rosterGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CMN_ROTA_ROSTER);
        rosterGr.addQuery("rota", shiftId);
        rosterGr.orderBy("order");
        rosterGr.query();
        var rosterList = [];
        while (rosterGr.next()) {
            rosterList.push({
                value: rosterGr.getUniqueValue(),
                display_value: rosterGr.getDisplayValue()
            });
        }
        var result = {
            value: rosterList[rosterNumber - 1].value,
            display_value: rosterList[rosterNumber - 1].display_value,
            label: gs.getMessage("Rotate through member")
        };
        return result;
    },
    getEscalationPolicyTemplateDetails: function(templateId, shiftId) {
        var response = {};
        if (!templateId)
            return response;
        var escPolicyTemplateGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.ESCALATION_POLICY_TEMPLATE);
        if (escPolicyTemplateGr.get(templateId)) {
            response = this.onCallCommon.toJS(escPolicyTemplateGr, ["name", "description"]);
            var escalationSteps = [];
            var escPolicyTemplateStepGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.ESCALATION_STEP_TEMPLATE);
            escPolicyTemplateStepGr.addQuery("escalation_policy_template", templateId);
            escPolicyTemplateStepGr.orderBy("step");
            escPolicyTemplateStepGr.query();
            var totalTimeDur = new GlideDuration(0);
            var tempDur = new GlideDuration();
            while (escPolicyTemplateStepGr.next()) {
                var escStepDetails = this.onCallCommon.toJS(escPolicyTemplateStepGr, ['name', 'reminders', 'time_between_reminders', 'time_to_next_step', 'rosters_position', 'roster_position_rtm', 'roster_escalation', 'sys_users', 'sys_user_groups', 'cmn_notif_devices', 'group_manager', 'group_manager_field', 'rotate_through_member']);
                escStepDetails.sys_id = {
                    "value": "-1"
                };
                escStepDetails.time_between_reminders.value = escStepDetails.time_between_reminders.value || "1970-01-01 00:00:00";
                escStepDetails.time_to_next_step.value = escStepDetails.time_to_next_step.value || "1970-01-01 00:15:00";
                escStepDetails.escalation_level = {
                    display_value: escPolicyTemplateStepGr.getDisplayValue("step"),
                    value: escPolicyTemplateStepGr.getValue("step"),
                    label: "Escalation level"
                };
                var users = escStepDetails.sys_users.value;
                if (users) {
                    users = users.split(",");
                    var userGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.SYS_USER);
                    var avatarsArr = [];
                    users.forEach(function(userId) {
                        if (userGr.get(userId)) {
                            avatarsArr.push(userGr.avatar ? "/" + userGr.avatar + ".iix?t=small" : "");
                        }
                    });
                    escStepDetails.sys_users.avatars = avatarsArr.join(", ");
                }
                escStepDetails.total_time_to_cur_step = {
                    value: totalTimeDur.getValue(),
                    duration_value: totalTimeDur.getDurationValue()
                };
                if (escStepDetails.rotate_through_member.value == "true")
                    escStepDetails.cmn_rota_roster_rtm = this._transformRosterFromTemplateRTM(escStepDetails.roster_position_rtm, shiftId);
                else
                    escStepDetails.cmn_rota_rosters = this._transformRosterFromTemplate(escStepDetails.rosters_position, shiftId);
                if (escStepDetails.time_between_reminders.value) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < escStepDetails.reminders.value; i++) {
                        tempDur.setValue(escStepDetails.time_between_reminders.value);
                        totalTimeDur = totalTimeDur.add(tempDur);
                    }
                }
                if (escStepDetails.time_to_next_step.value) {
                    tempDur.setValue(escStepDetails.time_to_next_step.value);
                    totalTimeDur = totalTimeDur.add(tempDur);
                }
                if (escStepDetails.cmn_rota_rosters || escStepDetails.cmn_rota_roster_rtm)
                    escalationSteps.push(escStepDetails);
            }
            response.escalation_steps = escalationSteps;
        }
        return response;
    },
    getContactPreferenceTemplateDetails: function(templateId) {
        var contactAttemptTemplateGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CONTACT_ATTEMPT_TEMPLATE);
        contactAttemptTemplateGr.addQuery(this.COLUMNS.PREFERENCE_TEMPLATE, templateId);
        contactAttemptTemplateGr.orderBy(this.COLUMNS.CONTACT_ATTEMPT);
        contactAttemptTemplateGr.query();
        var prefAttempt = [];
        while (contactAttemptTemplateGr.next()) {
            var attempt = {};
            attempt.contact_attempt = contactAttemptTemplateGr.getValue(this.COLUMNS.CONTACT_ATTEMPT);
            attempt.sys_id = "-1";
            attempt.communication_types = [];
            var commTypes = contactAttemptTemplateGr.getValue(this.COLUMNS.COMMUNICATION_TYPE);
            commTypes = commTypes.split(",");
            for (type in commTypes) {
                var commType = commTypes[type];
                var commTypeItem = {};
                var onCallCommTypeGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.ON_CALL_COMMUNICATION_TYPE);
                if (onCallCommTypeGr.get(commType)) {
                    commTypeItem.sys_id = commType;
                    commTypeItem.value = onCallCommTypeGr.getValue(this.COLUMNS.TYPE);
                    attempt.communication_types.push(commTypeItem);
                }
            }
            prefAttempt.push(attempt);
        }
        return prefAttempt;
    },

    getAudienceOptions: function() {
        return {
            users: {
                hide: false,
                disable: false
            },
            groups: {
                hide: false,
                disable: false
            },
            devices: {
                hide: false,
                disable: false
            }
        };
    },

    type: 'OnCallEscalationPolicyUIBUtilsSNC'
};]]></script>
